_comment: Phase 5 — register the ERP MCP server with Claude Desktop.
Copy the `mcpServers.erp-tools` block into that file, then:
1. replace MCP_ERP_JWT with a valid Supabase access token
(copy st.session_state.jwt from the Streamlit app, or sign in
via any tool that exposes the access_token),
2. adjust --directory to your absolute checkout path (Windows users:
use forward slashes or double-backslashes in JSON),
3. confirm MCP_ERP_API_BASE_URL matches your running apps/api service,
4. restart Claude Desktop — the tools appear in the tool-picker menu.
Verify: ask Claude Desktop 'list parties' — it will call list_parties
on this server and return the ERP response.
